---
applyTo: "**/*.ts,**/*.tsx,**/*.js,**/*.jsx,**/*.vue,**/*.html,**/*.css,**/*.scss"
---


Detect and follow the existing frontend framework and design system. Keep strict typing, accessible labels, keyboard support and responsive behavior. Display units and freshness for telemetry. Never represent stale data as current. Dangerous control actions need clear state, confirmation and error feedback.
